subject: maths
question: Alloy X contains 70% copper and 30% zinc. Alloy Y contains 40% copper, 25% zinc and 35% aluminium. Alloy X and Y are mixed in the ratio of 1 ∶ 3. What is the ratio of copper and zinc in the newly formed alloy?
solution: **Calculation** Alloy X and Y are mixed in the ratio of 1 ∶ 3. The ratio of copper to zinc in alloy X = 7x ∶ 3x ----(1) The ratio of copper to zinc to aluminium in alloy Y = 8x ∶ 5x : 7x ----(2) Multiply by 2 in equation (1) and multiply by 3 in equation (2)
